name: Tsushima Hakari
source:
Student body president and forgotten childhood friend of Kanisawa. Younger cousin of  Tsushima reo. Her intelligence is genius level inventing machines and contraptions to make things easier for her. Her major weakness being a poor athlete compare to peers but does show with determination she has good cardio. Similar to her cousin she loves bottle ships but unlike him she loves ships aspect rather than any items in bottle. Doesn't get along with Neko believing to be to strict. 

Likes: [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tamago_kake_gohan]Tamago kake[/url]
Dislikes: Exercise
Hobbies: Bottle ships, tinkering with mechanics
